method: Literal decimal m/l paths from the original municipal PDF Figure 77 Form stream. Only original nonzero line segments are polygonized, independently per source stroke object; no noding, buffer, repair, snap, simplification, image-frame closure or invented connecting edge. The central source cell retains both original holes. Six manually interpreted historical-map road junctions and literal current OSM-node coordinates fit an affine transform in EOV/EPSG:23700; a candidate southern road-junction/cycleway attachment is held out, with physical identity unconfirmed. Geographic placement is an explicit unverified estimate. Source contours are transformed to WGS84 without replacing them by current roads.
